items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: and good musicians like George Barnes, God bless his soul, he's gone. He had a knack....

ctx.x: you the whole thing -- for 28 years I've been in the phone book with that same number -- 358-2504 -- exchanged ...

Well, another beautiful thing in life was playing with -- now I've got small band playing under my finger, more or less, and I'm transpiring -- I know things that I couldn't play two years ago that I can play now. I am to a certain degree, getting better, I'm getting more proficient each year. When that comes to an end, I guess I'll just plod along. I get a little more tired -- but I can play better each year, something new comes along to me. If I'm playing with the right people; if I'm playing with my friends,…
